items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013

ctx.x: Do you know that there’s a little — now that you’re at Fredonia — there’s a little Fredonia story with Buddy. He came to play a concert, and this would have been probably ’72. And his piano player was either ill or whatever, they had no piano player that night. And Onaje Allen Gumbs —

Well, he was still a student here. And he played the whole concert with him. And Buddy Rich offered him the gig right on the bandstand, in the big hall, in King Hall. And of course all of us are going, “take it, take it!” I mean because that was our dream.
